svg.title: The step-limit bug. Three runs with max_steps 5. A run that finishes at step 3 gets no warning from either check. A run that finishes at exactly step 5 gets a false "limit hit" warning from step >= max_steps, but no warning from not done. A run stopped by the limit gets a warning from both. Only the run that finishes on exactly the last step is misreported.
